prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering steps, wait countdowns, tutorial screens, personality headlines, path duration hints, account sync hints, and initial flow bypasses improved performance.
Flow bypasses yielded mixed results, whereas major redesigns, trait selector flows, photo guidance, benefits copy, path time headlines, and account recovery hints significantly hurt performance.
Notifications, layout modifications, incentives, permission checks, and most remaining copy or hint updates showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains overall, particularly for major redesigns, trait selector flows, guide screens, and copy changes.
Predictions underestimated gains for pet control tutorial screens, wait countdowns, personality headlines, path duration hints, and account sync safety hints.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account pet persistence reassurance hint: Displays a clear sign-in hint promising that signing in saves your current pet and links existing pets safely. (why: Support receives 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and account sync safety hints previously improved performance.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop pet launch wait timer update: Displays an accurate time estimate and hint on the waiting screen while the desktop pet asset generates in the background. (why: Home step median time is 201s (mean 2336s) and lessons showed countdown hints significantly improve waiting step completion.)
2: [choose_path, reorder] Sign-in placement after companion selection: Moves sign-in immediately after pick_friend so users authenticate right after choosing their pet companion before photo upload. (why: Reordering sign-in closer to pet selection leverages high initial intent and prevents account reset issues noted in support mail.)
3: [finish, redesign] Checklist layout redesign for home welcome screen: Redesigns the final home intro screen using a checklist layout highlighting essential pet shortcut commands and visibility toggles. (why: Finish step has a long mean duration of 5815s and support users expressed post-onboarding confusion regarding pet desktop controls.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Path selection duration guidance hint: Adds a short contextual hint on the choose_path screen explaining that path selection takes under 10 seconds. (why: Choose_path step mean time is 514s despite 8s median, and duration hints previously proved effective for pacing users.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop ready status notification prompt: Enables readiness notification alerts on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while pet generation completes. (why: Mean time spent waiting on the home screen is 2336s; desktop ready notifications help users return promptly when complete.)

scores.note: Account sync safety hints address specific support complaints and are proven to perform well.
Wait countdown hints directly target high home screen mean duration and consistently lift conversion.
Reordering sign-in builds on high initial intent and aligns with strong past reorder results.
Major redesigns historically hurt performance significantly despite addressing user confusion.
Path duration hints effectively reduce dropoff from long duration perceptions with quick implementation.
Notifications have shown no clear historical effect despite addressing long waiting times.
